name: Optimizing the use of magnesium carbonate (chalk) in rock climbing
description: TIPE project (theme: Games and Sports) on the optimal use of climbing chalk. Studies its properties, notably the increase in friction coefficient and water adsorption, and compares it with other powders (talc, flour, chalk). Weighs its advantages and drawbacks, including effects on skin and dispersion, to propose a reasoned use that maximizes efficacy while limiting negative effects.
